sql: SELECT lo.id, lo.status, lo.cancel_reason, round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-lo.created_at))/60) AS age_min, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.live_order_id=lo.id) AS ticks_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.live_order_id=lo.id AND t.captured_at > now() - interval '60 minutes') AS ticks_60m, (SELECT max(t.captured_at)::text FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.live_order_id=lo.id) AS last_tick, (SELECT max(t.queue_position) FROM live_order_queue_ticks t WHERE t.live_order_id=lo.id AND t.captured_at > now() - interval '60 minutes') AS last_rank, (SELECT count(*) FROM fills f WHERE f.kalshi_order_id=lo.kalshi_order_id) AS fills FROM live_orders lo WHERE lo.status='resting' ORDER BY lo.created_at
